analysis.rationale: The remaining SFX work is one coupled end-to-end spatial-topology replacement across wrapper composition, side-owned binding, manifest injection, ADR/rules/docs, deterministic evidence, manual QA, and reconciliation of a substantial pre-existing dirty feature layer. Artificial server/client, code/test/docs, or deterministic/manual splits would compete for the same contracts and paths. Use one persistent integration Engineer with five explicit milestones.
analysis.seams_assessment: No stable independent vertical seam exists: server and client share the same wrapper/registry generation contract; runtime, focused tests, QA observations, rules, ADR, and current docs must converge together. Milestones are sequential evidence checkpoints, not separate writer slices.
analysis.working_set: High complexity but bounded for one persistent Engineer: baseline 8fd6bc621dd278e51086f00903a14151320b4169 plus 25 modified and 8 untracked pre-existing SFX paths; expected remaining 1 new runtime module, 1 new ADR, 12-18 existing paths, 600-1200 additional lines; hard baseline budget 42 product files and 8500 changed lines, with a 10-runtime-file/900-production-line remaining sub-budget.
